title: Rollout activity timeline + audit history UI (diff view, actor, timestamps)
creator: Kenji Nakamura
description:
Goal
Design the Console UI for (1) Rollout activity timeline (human-readable history) and (2) Audit history (compliance-oriented log with diffs) for Hosted canary rollouts. This ticket covers the single-rollout page experience plus empty/error states.

Why
We’re taking beta rollout primitives to GA. Customers need to confidently answer:
- What changed, when, and by whom?
- What was the effective configuration at any point in time?
- Can I show a compliance trail (create/update/pause/rollback) with before/after?

Scope
1) Activity timeline (default view)
- Timeline list of events tied to a specific rollout.
- Event types: Created, Updated configuration, Step advanced (manual), Schedule progressed (timed), Paused, Resumed, Rolled back, Guardrail tripped (auto-pause), Validation blocked (attempted), Deleted/archived (if supported later).
- Each event includes: timestamp, actor, summary, and optional “View diff” when a configuration change occurred.

2) Audit history (tab / toggle)
- More “log-like” view with filtering and a diff panel.
- Must align with Security audit event spec: event type, actor attribution, before/after payload (sanitized), and immutable timestamps.
- Export is out of scope for UI (but ensure layout can accommodate “copy event ID” / deep link).

3) Diff view (side panel)
- Before/after comparison for changes to:
  - Traffic split weights (baseline/candidate)
  - Candidate model/version
  - Stickiness setting (off / request-hash)
  - Schedule steps (added/removed/reordered)
  - Guardrails (latency threshold, error-rate threshold, max cost delta)
  - Quality gates toggle + linked eval (if present)
- Highlight changes inline (added/removed/modified). Avoid JSON unless user explicitly expands “Raw payload”.

4) States
- Empty state: no activity events yet (new rollout) and “no results” after filters.
- Error state: cannot load events; partial load; permission denied.
- Loading: skeleton rows; diff panel loading state.

Non-goals
- Cross-rollout / org-wide audit browsing (future: “Audit logs” global page).
- Editing from timeline (timeline is read-only; actions remain in header controls).
- Statistical analysis UI (handled by canary comparison dashboards).

Primary UX decisions / spec
A) Page structure
- Rollout detail page header: rollout name, route, baseline/candidate chips, current traffic split, status pill.
- Below header: tabs
  - Overview (existing)
  - Monitoring (existing)
  - Activity (new; default for this ticket)
- Activity tab contains:
  - Left: timeline list
  - Right: details/diff panel (collapsible; appears when an item with details is selected)

B) Timeline row anatomy
- Icon + event label
- Secondary line: actor + source (Console / API / System)
- Tertiary: short summary (e.g., “Traffic split 90/10 → 75/25”, “Paused due to latency guardrail”) 
- Right aligned: timestamp in user’s locale with hover for ISO + timezone.

Actor format
- Prefer: Full name + email on hover.
- If actor is deleted/unavailable: show “Unknown actor” with audit actor_id in tooltip.
- System events: “Redwood system”.

C) Filters (Activity + Audit)
- Filter chips: Event type, Actor, Source, Date range.
- Audit view additionally supports: “Only configuration changes” toggle.
- Keep filters shallow (no advanced query builder) to limit complexity for GA.

D) Diff panel
- Default: “Human diff” sections (Traffic, Models, Guardrails, Schedule, Routing)
- Each section shows “No changes” if untouched.
- Provide “View raw payload” expand at bottom for debugging/support.

Diff rendering rules (human diff)
- Percentages: always show normalized totals and validate sum to 100 (read-only display; if backend provides normalized weights, show both requested + effective when they differ).
- Guardrails: show thresholds and whether enabled.
- Schedule steps: show step list with step index; changes highlight added/removed steps.

E) Empty & error states
- Empty (no events yet):
  - Title: “No activity yet”
  - Copy: “Changes to this rollout (like traffic shifts, pauses, and rollbacks) will appear here.”
  - CTA: none (avoid pushing user into action from an audit surface).
- No results after filters:
  - Title: “No events match your filters”
  - CTA: “Clear filters”
- Error loading:
  - Title: “Activity couldn’t be loaded”
  - Copy: “Try again. If this persists, contact support with the request ID.”
  - CTA: “Retry”
- Permission denied:
  - Title: “You don’t have access to audit history”
  - Copy: “Ask an admin to grant the Rollouts:ViewAudit permission.” (wording subject to final RBAC naming)

F) Accessibility
- Timeline items keyboard navigable (up/down to move selection; enter to open diff panel).
- Screen reader labels for event type, timestamp, and actor.
- Don’t rely on color-only highlights in diff.

Open questions (for Eng/Product)
1) Event taxonomy: do we distinguish “Pause (manual)” vs “Auto-pause (guardrail)”? Proposed: yes, separate event types.
2) How do we represent “timed progression”: one event per step transition vs one event at schedule start with derived entries? Proposed: one event per transition (clear audit).
3) Raw payload format: do we show backend JSON as-is or a redacted/normalized version? Proposed: show redacted/sanitized payload consistent with Security spec.
4) Pagination: timeline is paginated; do we offer infinite scroll or page controls? Proposed: infinite scroll + “Back to top” to match other Console logs.

References / links
- Confluence UI spec (rollout wizard + screens): sources/confluence/product-docs/design-specs/console-hosted-canary-rollout-ui-spec.json
- Audit events spec: sources/confluence/security-and-compliance/audit-logging/rollout-policy-change-audit-events.json
- ADR sticky routing: sources/confluence/architecture-and-standards/decision-records/adr-038-sticky-routing-strategy-for-canaries.json
- ADR streaming semantics: sources/confluence/architecture-and-standards/decision-records/adr-039-streaming-session-semantics-in-rollouts.json

Design deliverables
- Figma: “Hosted Rollouts GA – Activity & Audit” (page includes: Activity tab, Audit tab, Diff panel, empty/error states, responsive breakpoints)
- Redlines for diff highlighting + typography
- Component usage notes for Design Systems (TimelineRow, DiffSection, FilterChips)

Acceptance criteria
- Users can view a chronological list of rollout events with timestamps and actor attribution.
- Selecting a configuration-changing event opens a diff that clearly shows what changed.
- Empty and error states are defined (copy + layout) and meet accessibility standards.
- Handoff notes cover mapping of UI event labels to backend event types + fields needed to render diffs.

Handoff notes (engineering)
- Minimum fields per event row: event_id, event_type, created_at, actor_display_name, actor_type (user/system), source (console/api/system), summary (optional), has_diff (bool).
- Diff requires: before_state + after_state (or a precomputed diff) for: weights, model/version, stickiness, schedule steps, guardrails.
- If only after_state is available for some events, diff panel should degrade to “Current configuration snapshot at this time” with a banner: “Diff unavailable for this event.”
comments: 2025-01-16 — Paula Mendes (PM): Please make sure the audit view aligns with compliance expectations: immutable timestamps, actor, and before/after. We’ve had multiple requests for ‘who changed rollout weights’ specifically.

2025-01-17 — Felix Schneider (Eng): From backend we’ll have event types: rollout.created, rollout.updated, rollout.paused, rollout.resumed, rollout.rollback, rollout.step_changed (manual), rollout.auto_paused.guardrail. We can provide before/after for updated + step_changed; others will have after-only. Suggest design for missing before-state.

2025-01-22 — Marcus Lin (Security): Avoid showing full request payloads (prompts, user content) in audit history. Policy diffs are OK. Raw payload must be sanitized and should not contain any customer text. Include request_id/event_id for correlation; email can be displayed but consider least-privilege (depends on RBAC).

2025-01-24 — Svetlana Orlov (Design Systems): TimelineRow should reuse existing “Activity feed” token set; avoid introducing new icon sizes. Provide spacing/redline notes for collapsed vs expanded details panel.

2025-01-29 — Dylan Brooks (Eng Lead, Console): We’ll implement infinite scroll with cursor pagination. Can you confirm if you want the diff panel as a right-side drawer (persistent) vs modal? Drawer is easier to keep context.
2025-01-29 — Kenji Nakamura (Design): Confirmed: right-side drawer, resizable, remembers last open state per session. Modal only for ‘raw payload’ if needed later.

2025-02-04 — Jada Williams (Workflow): Please ensure we display ‘effective weights’ vs ‘requested weights’ when guardrails force candidate to 0% (auto-pause). Users get confused when timeline says 10% but traffic is actually 0%.

2025-02-07 — Kenji Nakamura (Design): Final spec + empty/error states shipped in Figma. Added banner behavior for ‘effective vs requested’ and a specific event label for guardrail-triggered auto-pause. Ready for engineering handoff.
